intro: Webwood Ichor is a fluid harvested from Webwood spiders prowling Teldrassil. Dirania Silvershine needs it, along with hyacinth mushrooms and moonpetal lilies, to brew an antidote for the poisoned Iverron.

p: The Webwood spiders that haunt Shadowglen carry a venom dangerous enough to leave Iverron gravely ill. Dirania Silvershine asks for ichor from these spiders, along with hyacinth mushrooms and moonpetal lilies, to prepare an antidote.
